summary: Vora AI OCR scan + enhance feature verified end-to-end. Backend: 10 new pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_scan_enhance_api.py all pass (1 soft-skip for blank image). Full suite 46/46 (36 previous + 10 new) still green. POST /api/books/scan with a JPEG rendered via PIL (Italian text 'La divina commedia / Nel mezzo del cammin / di nostra vita') returns {source:'scan', ocr_engine:'ai', file_type:'pdf', pages:1}; GET /api/books/{id}/content returns source='scan' and a non-empty transcription; the book appears in GET /api/books carrying the two new fields. Edge cases: missing auth → 401, empty file list → 400, unknown book → 404, non-scan book → 400 ('Disponibile solo per i libri scansionati'), cross-user access → 404. POST /api/books/{id}/enhance for the seeded old-scan book 5d8d8071fb794c308393a02664b0076a (no stored photos) succeeded in <10s, response source='scan' and ocr_engine∈{'ai','mixed'}, page count preserved. Regression confirmed: every book in /api/books now carries source and ocr_engine fields; TTS and upload endpoints unaffected. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): logged in as test@leggimi.it, scan sheet shows subtitle 'Le pagine saranno lette dall'AI' as required; scanned book reader (Test Scan 5d8d8071…) renders reader-enhance-button under the page counter, tapping it switched to 'Miglioramento in corso…' then displayed reader-enhance-message 'Testo migliorato con l'AI.' and reloaded page text; non-scan PDF book (freshly uploaded TEST_ui_nonscan.pdf, source=null) does NOT render reader-enhance-button — condition `content?.source === 'scan'` is correctly enforced. Button label restored to 'Migliora testo con AI' after completion. Deprecated packages detected: none.
action_items: No functional fixes required for this iteration. Everything in the review request works as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py scan_book: images are stored to object storage BEFORE OCR, with per-page semaphore of 4. image_paths list is persisted alongside the pages array in book_pages, enabling enhance to re-read the originals.

server.py enhance_book: two branches are correct — if a photo path exists, it re-reads bytes and calls ai_ocr (fresh AI pass); otherwise it falls back to run_llm(FIX_SYSTEM, UserMessage(pages[i])) which fixes extracted-text artefacts of old Tesseract runs. 502 is raised only when zero pages improved, which is the correct bulk-failure signal.

Book pydantic model now exposes source and ocr_engine as Optional[str]; non-scan books serialize them as null which is the shape the Reader frontend conditionally renders against (`content?.source === 'scan'`).
Reader uses buzz()+stop() before enhance to interrupt ongoing TTS synthesis — prevents the AudioPlayer from playing stale pre-enhance audio.

api.enhanceBook wraps the POST in a 300s AbortController timeout, which is safely larger than the backend's AI budget (semaphore 4 × a few seconds per page). No hardcoded URL in reader; EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL used throughout.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (login, scan-sheet subtitle, enhance button visibility rules, enhance click flow with before/after labels and message)

seed_data_creation: Scan test created one TEST_ scan book which was deleted at the end of the run. Also uploaded a TEST_ui_nonscan.pdf during UI testing to verify the enhance button is hidden on non-scan books; deleted at cleanup. Pre-existing seeded books 5d8d8071fb794c308393a02664b0076a (Test Scan, old no-photo scan) and 12a4e3db9d954e87a7919fa7823cb57e (Dante AI, has photo) were used read-mostly; the old-scan one was enhanced once as part of the test (AI call ~a few seconds; within the budget). All TEST_ books cleaned up after run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v` from /app/backend (pytest.ini pins -n 2 loadscope). The scan+enhance suite depends on EMERGENT_LLM_KEY being valid; test_enhance_old_scan_without_photos gracefully pytest.skip()s on 502 so a temporary LLM outage won't fail the run, but a real regression will show as the 10 non-skip cases failing. Known-good seeded books for the test user: 5d8d8071fb794c308393a02664b0076a (old scan, no photos) and 12a4e3db9d954e87a7919fa7823cb57e (new scan with stored photo). The reader hides the enhance button via `content?.source === 'scan'` — this is content-based (not book metadata), so GET /api/books/{id}/content must keep returning the `source` field. In the login screen, testIDs are suffixed with -input/-button (e.g. login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button), not the shorter login-email etc.
